scripts.dev:e2e: rm -rf .wrangler-e2e/state && E2E=true bun run db:migration:apply:e2e && E2E=true vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort
scripts.db:migration:apply:local: bun run db:migration:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply static-host-db --local
scripts.db:migration:apply:e2e: bun run db:migration:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply static-host-db --local --persist-to .wrangler-e2e/state
scripts.db:migration:apply:prod: bun run db:migration:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply static-host-db --remote
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run db:migration:apply:prod && wrangler deploy --config dist/static_host/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:dry-run: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/static_host/wrangler.json --dry-run
